en.title: Super Galaxy Delivery ★ Full Course: The Time‑Stopping Pocket Watch and the Forbidden Recipe
en.premise: Atashi, the galaxy’s top foodie courier, stumbles upon a broken pocket watch in a junkyard. But this watch doesn’t just mark time—it points toward the most delicious ingredients around. To complete a legendary full‑course meal, she boards a flying delivery ship and embarks on a perilous, mouth‑watering adventure across exotic planets.

zh.title: 超银河配送★全套餐：停时怀表与禁忌食谱
zh.premise: Atashi——银河最顶尖的美食快递员——在废品城捡到一只破旧的怀表。它不只是计时器，而是指引周围最美味食材的指南针。为了完成传说中的全套餐，她登上飞行配送船，踏上一次危险又令人垂涎的星际冒险之旅。
